We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Ex Commercial Founder (m/f/d) Your Role

As Ex Commercial Founder at fonio, you own one of our products. You're not just shaping the roadmap; you're accountable for the commercial success of the product. Strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and growth all sit with you.

You'll operate like a mini-CEO for your product: making the calls, running the experiments, and carrying the numbers. You won't do it alone: you're paired with a technical counterpart and together you own the product.

What you'll do

 * Own a product - from strategy and roadmap to go-to-market and revenue

 * Define positioning, pricing, and the commercial strategy for your product

 * Work directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship and grow fast

 * Own the metrics that matter - adoption, retention, and revenue - and be accountable for them

 * Run discovery: talk to customers, validate problems, and decide what gets built

What We Offer

 * Up to €150.000 OTE + equity.

 * On-site in Vienna, Munich, Barcelona or London - relocation package to Vienna if needed.

 * Real ownership of a fonio product: you get to essentially work like an entrepreneur inside of fonio.

 * Maximum autonomy - you run your product like your own company.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.

What You Bring

 * Demonstrated track record as a founder or commercial owner - you've built and launched a B2B SaaS product & owned it end to end from the commercial side.

 * Strong commercial instinct: you think in terms of markets, customers, and revenue

 * Comfortable operating with high ambiguity and no predefined structure

 * Sharp analytical thinking paired with a bias for execution

 * Excellent communication in English; German is a strong plus given our DACH focus

 * Bonus: experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, or voice technology

1 Senior AI Solution Consultant_in Your Tasks
 * Use Case Ownership: Take a broad, messy client ask through to a decision people stand behind, with the business value made explicit and the trade-offs written down.
 * Problem Framing: Make competing asks comparable, decide what gets solved first, and put the reasoning on the table.
 * Stakeholder Reality: Bring the people who ask for a solution and the people who will work with it behind one decision.
 * AI Judgment: Draw the line between what AI should do and what it should not, and say what has to be measured for people to trust the result.
 * Structured Intent: Capture the what and the why, so that engineers and AI agents can build the how.
 * High-Stakes Facilitation: Design and run formats with senior stakeholders from product, engineering and compliance, producing alignment in the room.
 * Rapid Prototyping: Put a working artefact in front of a stakeholder instead of a concept, using today's AI tooling.
 * Client Capability: Build enablement formats, reusable AI artefacts and skills that client teams operate themselves after we leave.
 * Governance Early: Bring classification, controls, auditability and cost implications into the picture at the start, not at the end.
 * Multiplication: Turn what you learn into playbooks and templates your colleagues use in their own delivery.

Your Qualifications
 * Structured Thinking: You give shape to something vague, form a view early, and stay sharp when you go deeper.
 * Product Thinking: Strong instinct for value and users, and you can say what a use case is worth before anyone builds it.
 * Consulting Track Record: Several years in consulting, product or transformation roles, ideally in regulated industries, with topics you carried to a decision rather than only contributed to.
 * AI Judgment: Clear-eyed on where LLMs fit and where they do not, on the failure modes, and on how to prove an output is correct. You work with your own workflows, agents and skills, and stay critical of what comes back.
 * Technical Fluency: Confident in conversations on modern software delivery, LLMs, agents and RAG, without needing to build production systems yourself.
 * Composure: You hold a position under pressure with senior people, and change it when someone brings the better argument.
 * AI Governance is a plus: EU AI Act risk classification, human-in-the-loop, auditability, any exposure to DORA or GDPR/DPIA.
 * Languages: Fluent communication in German and English.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 63.000 
and € 75.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it! 1 Product Manager - Construction & Real Estate (PropTech) (m/f/d) Job description

We're now looking for a Product Manager with experience in the construction industry to take our platform to the next level- owning the roadmap, pricing, and scope along the way. Not managing. Shaping.

Your mission

 * The roadmap across all product areas. You decide what ships next - and you stand behind the why.

 * The path from prototype to platform. You sequence the porting effort in waves, cut scope where it's needed, and keep the codebases together instead of letting them drift apart.

 * Pricing and packaging. You align packaging with sales, keep the unit economics of compute-intensive simulation runs healthy, and own the Stripe catalog end-to-end.

 * Discovery and delivery with customers. You run pilot projects, sit down with asset managers and engineers, translate what you hear into specs, and make sure the platform's reports and studies hold up with customers.

 * Quality standards for simulation results. Engineers have to trust the numbers. You define, per engine, what "good enough to ship" means, and you manage the trade-off between physical accuracy and product speed.

 * The written trail. PRDs, a well-maintained decision log, release notes. Our rule: if it isn't documented, it didn't happen.

Your profile

 * Product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment - with substantial time spent on a technical or data-intensive product.

 * Experience in - or hands-on exposure to - the construction industry.

 * An AI-native way of working: for you, AI is a tool, not a buzzword.

 * Real technical confidence. You question a data model, follow a discussion with engineers, and understand a simulation output well enough to challenge it.

 * A degree that connects building energy systems, simulation, and building operations across engineering disciplines - or equivalent hands-on competence in building analysis and simulation

 * Fluent English; professional German strongly preferred.

Why us?

 * Real impact. Your product decisions feed into real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - a complete product portfolio rather than isolated one-off projects.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option & a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000.00 - €80,000.00 gross/year.

1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
